thread:
maya_support: FYI, ACME reported intermittent JSON-mode failures after our canary to llama4b-v2. They're seeing their `items` array become `null` or missing entirely. Request ID: req_0a1b2c3d. Repro steps attached below.

jordan_oncall: Can you drop the minimal repro and the exact model tag they hit? Also include any request headers (model, inputs, structured_output flag).

maya_support: Repro (curl):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"llama4b-v2-quant-canary","mode":"json","prompt":"list items for order 123"}'
```
Example responses they received:
Valid:
```
{"order_id":123, "items":[{"id":"sku1","qty":1},{"id":"sku2","qty":2}]}
```
Invalid (observed):
```
{"order_id":123, "items": null,}
```
or completely missing `items` key. Parser on their side throws "unexpected token `}`" or returns null-pointer. :worried:

rachel_sre: Noted. Two quick asks: 1) can we pull an inference trace for req_0a1b2c3d (kernel selection, quant flags, kv cache state), 2) were there any runtime kernel swaps during that canary window? @deploy-bot can you post the deploy event?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout of llama4b-v2-quant to 10% completed at 2026-03-16T14:05:12Z (tag: llama4b-v2-quant-canary). No autoscale events logged in that minute.

jordan_oncall: I'm seeing a cluster log snippet where the structured-output postprocessor got an empty token buffer and still attempted to finalize JSON. Log: ```postproc: finalize_json: token_buffer.len=0, wrote "items": null; err=none``` That suggests an off-by-one in the prefix-eligibility check when quantized kernels emit an early EOS token.

maya_support: Customer confirms issue reproduced with short responses only (when items count==0). They say it worked before the canary. They need either a rollback or a compatibility patch.

rachel_sre: My plan: roll the canary back to previous tag for all 10% hosts, collect traces and add a guard in the postprocessor to avoid emitting `,` or `null` for omitted arrays. @jordan can you instrument a quick check for empty token buffer -> emit "items": [] instead of "null" as a safe default?

jordan_oncall: Will do. Pushing a hotfix to the canary group now and rolling back canary hosts. I'll also add an eval that hits the short zero-items path.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: reverting hosts with tag llama4b-v2-quant-canary -> llama4b-v1-stable at 2026-03-16T14:21:07Z.

maya_support: ACME confirmed after rollback that their webhook replay now parses cleanly. They saw 5 failures in the 14:05–14:20 window, zero failures post-rollback. Customer requested a postmortem and a remediation timeline. :thumbsup:

rachel_sre: I'll prepare a brief incident note (root cause: postprocessor assumed non-empty token stream; contributing factor: quantized canary emitted quick EOS for short outputs). Will include mitigation (hotfix + guard + regression eval) and rollout plan.

maya_support: Thanks team — ping me when the hotfix is in prod so I can close the ticket and update ACME.

jordan_oncall: Hotfix deployed to prod canaries with the guard in place. Adding regression test to CI. Will post PR link shortly. :eyes:
